    18	enum DeviceKeyAuthHandler {
    19	    static func handle(error: Error) -> String? {
    20	        guard isDeviceKeyAuthError(error) else { return nil }
    21	        let message = deviceKeyAuthMessage(for: error)
    22	        DispatchQueue.main.async {
    23	            NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .deviceKeyAuthRequired, object: nil, userInfo: ["message": message])

    28	    private static func isDeviceKeyAuthError(_ error: Error) -> Bool {
    29	        guard let apiError = error as? MiataruAPIClient.APIError else { return false }
    30	        switch apiError {
    31	        case .serverError(let statusCode, let message):
    32	            if statusCode == 401 || statusCode == 403 {
    33	                return true
    34	            }
    35	            let lowercased = message.lowercased()
    36	            return lowercased.contains("devicekey") || lowercased.contains("device key")
    37	        default:
    38	            return false
    39	        }
    40	    }

    42	    private static func deviceKeyAuthMessage(for error: Error) -> String {
    43	        guard let apiError = error as? MiataruAPIClient.APIError else {
    44	            return NSLocalizedString("device_key_auth_required_message", comment: "Message when device key authentication is required")
    45	        }
    46	        switch apiError {
    47	        case .serverError(_, let message):
    48	            let lowercased = message.lowercased()
    49	            if lowercased.contains("does not match") || lowercased.contains("doesn't match") {
    50	                return NSLocalizedString("device_key_auth_mismatch_message", comment: "Message when stored DeviceKey does not match server")
